column3: evidence (Salama
column6: UCC 2019; arXiv:1911.03527 full text; GitHub m-salama/IotNetSim)

column3: sensor nodes (fixed and mobile) submit readings from CSV datasets at reading intervals (Sec. 4.III)
nodes 'could also be configured as actuators by implementing the required actions'; no built-in actuator model, not evaluated (Sec. 4.II-III)
data packets and streams tracked with size across nodes on the CloudSim event engine; connection types with signal, range, capacity, power model; no protocol-stack/MAC simulation (Sec. 4.I, 4.III)
connection types Wi-Fi, 3G, Bluetooth, LoRa, Zigbee, short/long-range radio; no application protocols (MQTT/CoAP) (Sec. 4.III)
edge, fog and cloud layers, each optional (Sec. 3)
evaluated loops end in cloud storage/alerts; actuation left to user-implemented actions (Sec. 4.II, 5)
node locations configurable to study placement; automatic placement is future work (Sec. 4.I, 8)
DatacenterBroker extended with queuing models for runtime adaptation; no autoscaling described (Sec. 4.III)
mobility of sensors, but no handover or service migration described
network loss, disconnection and battery failures can be modelled; recovery via user actions; not evaluated (Sec. 3, 6)
no software/firmware updates or retirement
mobile sensors change (x,y,z) from CSV, randomly or by pattern (Sec. 4.III); not evaluated
battery tracking per node, power model per connection, host/VM energy (Sec. 4.I, 4.III)
device and datacentre energy, no carbon
VMs only, no containers or microservices
security left to user-implemented algorithms; no model of its overhead (Sec. 4.III)
no correlated failures
no joint compute-network decisions described
single fidelity
CloudSim-derived datacentre model (same convention as other CloudSim descendants); no cost results reported
no ML/RL interface
each point is the mean of 30 runs; no seeds, confidence intervals or scenario files reported (Sec. 5)
authors state 'a lack of validating the simulation accuracy against the real system'; validation traces event flow only (Sec. 6)
no reference policies or benchmarks
no GUI described; Java API
run time and memory up to 1,000,000 sensors on the JOSE case (Sec. 5.II)
open source (GitHub m-salama/IotNetSim), last updated Nov 2019
